content:
Alex M: Hey team — last-minute thing. I need to step away tonight 22:00 UTC -> 06:00 UTC due to a family situation. Can someone pick up primary for that window? I can shadow until 22:00 but can't take pages after that. Primary = ack pages, own bridge, follow runbooks, escalate per PD policy.

OncallBot: :rotating_light: Reminder: primary must ACK pages within 5m. If you take over, update the rotation spreadsheet and set yourself as primary in /ops/oncall/rotation.

Mira K: I can cover 22:00–02:00 UTC (primary). Can someone take 02:00–06:00?

Samir R: I was planned for EU infra rotation overnight but I can swap my infra duties and take 02:00–06:00 if Jen can handle the infra checks tomorrow morning. @Jen T?

Jen T: I can take 02:00–06:00 and do the infra checks after my shift. Quick note for whoever is primary: if you see a "model-unavailable" page, follow the model availability runbook — immediate steps are to check model process on the serving nodes, confirm KV cache health, and flip to the fallback model variant. Runbook: https://redwood.ops/runbooks/model-availability (bookmark).

Liam O: If pages point to p99 latency spikes, check regional routing first. For EU->US fallback we have routing policy "latency-fallback-eu->us" that can be toggled in Console > Routing > Policies. Also watch the batching queue depth metric (serving/runtime/batcher/queue_depth) — if > 80% for 3 consecutive mins, consider temporary smaller-quant model.

IncidentBot: [automated] New pager test received: tokenization-error (no customer impact) — this is a test.

Alex M: Thanks @Mira @Jen @Samir. I'll update the rotation sheet and add handoff notes. Handoff checklist (I'll paste in thread for whoever takes primary):

```
1) ACK pager in PD and update PD notes with your name/time
2) Open incident bridge if multiple pages or customer impact
3) Check Console > Models > Current to confirm active model variant
4) Look at serving/runtime logs: `kubectl logs -l app=redwood-serving -n inference --tail=200`
5) If model-unavailable, run the quick fix: `curl -X POST https://internal-admin/restart-model?node=<node>`
6) Route to fallback in Console if needed (see Liam note)
7) Escalate to eng-sre if you can't restore within 15 minutes
```

Mira K: Acked. I'll take primary 22:00–02:00 and will open #incident-bridge if anything pops. I'll also pin the runbook link. @Samir / @Jen confirm you two can swap so we have continuous coverage. :thumbsup:

Samir R: Confirmed — I'll be primary 02:00–06:00. Will keep my phone on.

Jen T: Confirmed. I'll handle infra checks and follow up in the morning. One more note: if you get repeated "fallback model degraded" alerts, disable autoscale burst for that model for the short window (Console -> Models -> Advanced -> Autoscale Burst = off) until we validate.

Alex M: You're all lifesavers, thank you. I updated the spreadsheet and left the handoff note in PD. I'll set an away message on Slack. Good luck and ping me only for unavoidable escalations.

OncallBot: :white_check_mark: Rotation updated: Mira K (primary 22:00–02:00), Jen T (primary 02:00–06:00), Samir R (secondary shadow 02:00–06:00).

Mira K: Leaving final quick handoff note pinned — "check model-availability runbook, routing policy, batcher queue, and PD escalation chain (primary->secondary->eng-sre)". I'll monitor until 22:00 then take full ownership.

IncidentBot: [automated] Thread pinned to #eng-oncall for handoff visibility.

Alex M: Thanks again — I'll log off now.
